title: The variance-matched Rademacher--Gaussian score has quartic Fisher cost

scalar_channel.law: Y_t=sqrt(t) epsilon+sqrt(1-t) Z with independent symmetric Rademacher epsilon and standard Gaussian Z, 0<t<1.
scalar_channel.normalization: E Y_t=0 and Var(Y_t)=1 exactly; its density is positive and smooth.
scalar_channel.hermite_expansion: p_t/phi=1-(t^2/12)H_4+O(t^3) and s_t=-(t^2/3)H_3+O(t^3) in Gaussian-weighted norms.
scalar_channel.fisher: j(t)=E s_t(Y_t)^2=(2/3)t^4+O(t^5); hence j(t)<=C t^4 for 0<t<=t_0.
scalar_channel.scope_guard: This is a scalar channel identity; leading descent also requires the K1572-weighted block trace and cardinal-packet fourth-mass lower bound.
